name: Skyline Assassin
summary:
STEP OUT INTO THE OPEN SKY. THE FRONT DOOR IS A TRAP.

Become Julian Vance, an elite rogue agent dismantling a corporate conspiracy from the outside in. In **Skyline Assassin**, high-rises are multi-layered vertical puzzle boxes. Blending high-altitude VR climbing, physics-based spy tools, and deep social disguise mechanics, how you infiltrate and execute is 100% your choice.

**🔥 VERTIGO CLIMBING**
Manually grab narrow pipes, traverse scaffolding, and conquer structural steel beams hundreds of feet above
